label: Blind sample 048: Hansen forest loss 2023, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2023 (90% interval −0.24 to −0.04). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 3 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.07). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). The control trajectory tracked the area less closely than usual before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.02); the fit check passed only because the change is more than 4 times that error.

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14); radar has too few observations to weigh in.

notes: kept cells whose dominant land cover is tree cover like the area
kept cells within 150 m of the area's elevation (390 m)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 80
